items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He said, I sound just like, uh, Big Chief, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh.

ctx.x: Oh, what did that guy say to you at the, what was it, the Yacht Club or the Country Club? Uh, that guy, the waiter comes up to you and plays you a high compliment, remember? The guy from Cuba?
He said, I sound just like, uh, Big Chief, huh?
